x: Held at Brighton in perfect weather only John Knifton and Ken Bailey showed good form, with the team having to be content with 6th place. Surrey W.C. took the title, thanks to Fullager and Nihill who were 1st and 2nd!
Paul Nihill walked beautifully to win from his clubmate Fullager (M) with Eric Hall a creditable third. 4th January 1964 - The Juniors entered a team in the Essex Beagles Open 3¾.
The Fullagers of Surrey WC chased our men all the way, but there was little doubt our two would remain ahead. Once again Ray Hall played the true captain's part.
